No, my memory doesn't give me permission to cancel or cut tests. It records the owner as against **useless tests** and **repeated identical CI runs**. It also says he **never asked** me to cancel tests or reduce the delegate count.

His standing rules still apply: "no unit tests", and checks should run once per tree (the `checkOnce` change). The fix for repeated runs was to dedupe them, not to drop coverage.

I don't have his exact words from late on 10-15, so I can't quote them. If you want to cut tests, ask him through AskUserQuestion first.
